provenance.calibrationMethod: constant robust vertical offset = median(USGS local-day peak NAVD88 - NOAA verified hourly local-day peak NAVD88), fit on complete calendar years 2021-2025; 3-IQR difference screen; leave-one-year-out validation
provenance.crestStationName: Rahway River at US Route 1 at Rahway NJ

trendSource.method: ordinary least squares of monthly means of bias-corrected NOAA verified daily highs

returnIntervals.method: Gumbel method-of-moments fit to water-year maxima from the canonical USGS-first, bias-corrected NOAA, USGS-crest-override composite
